newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB forms wholesale banking unit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB forms wholesale banking unit.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) said on Tuesday it had formed a global wholesale banking unit to develop world-class capabilities in treasury, capital markets, specialised finance and corporate banking.

The bank said the new unit would be headed by Michael Soden, who had been appointed group general manager, global wholesale banking. Soden was formerly general manager of the bank's wholesale banking activities in Europe.

"Our corporate customers are one of the group's key customer segments. They are becoming more global in their operations and their outlook and we are upgrading our wholesale banking services accordingly," NAB's managing director Don Argus said.
Argus said the bank had already begun establishing its global wholesale unit with the formation of wholesale banking units in Europe, Australia, New Zealand and the United States.
"This has included the appointment and recruitment of key personnel. This process will continue under the leadership of Michael Soden," Argus said.
Argus said the new division would offer a broader range of solutions to corporate customers, which would help to create stronger and more diversified revenue streams.
